g.text: Sequence Diagram - VIS04 Textures and Materials (PBR Creation, Asset Override, Failure & Disposal)
Precondition: the VIS01 activeConfigurationParser has checked that every *MapAssetId exists
and is a TEXTURE asset (BR 13); all textures and glTF models are preloaded into LoadedAssets.
The WEB06 back end has already applied MATERIAL_REQUIRED, INCOMPLETE_TEXTURE_SET and
MODEL_TEXTURES_MISSING (BR 6, BR 7). Every map is ALWAYS cloned: LoadedAssets is never mutated.
1. Material factory creation (one per build, D15)
2. Room surfaces and procedural elements (required = true)
color map + one of roughness / normal / bump (BR 6);
cache lookup by JSON of dto (D5):
hit -> return the same material (steps below skipped)
[for each map present in dto (color, roughness, normal, bump)]
Normal and bump maps may be used together (D10).
Normal maps follow the OpenGL convention.
color tints the color map and roughness multiplies
the roughness map: the defaults keep the maps unchanged.
new MeshStandardMaterial({ color, map, roughness, roughnessMap,
room surfaces have UVs in metres (VIS02 D7)
UVs in metres per face (D13, VIS04-ALN-4)
root (own skeleton; source model unchanged, D16)
keep the model's own materials and textures (BR 8)
scalars only: absent scalars not filled)
[dto has maps (complete set; e.g. embeddedTextureSet = false, BR 7)]
root.traverse() with Map<original, clone>: for each Mesh and each
original material (array entries too): reuse the clone if it exists,
otherwise clone = original.clone() and set only the given
color / roughness / metalness; replace on the mesh
one tinted clone per distinct material (same map, normalMap, ...)
4. Invalid material: the build fails (D7, D11)
dispose the partial build (section 5): the factory
releases what it had already created
state "failed" (VIS01); no substitute material or texture
Floor / walls: create() is called by KitchenLayoutModule,
with no element id; the MaterialBuildError propagates
unchanged and the viewer also shows "failed".
Reload, close, switch of the active configuration, or failed build
[for each mat in createdMaterials[] (factory materials and tinted clones)]
Releases ONLY what the factory created; a second
source models and their materials stay untouched.
base models and original textures released
